source: docs/design/proposals/2026-11-melee-techniques.md and 2026-11-ranged-techniques.md (Physical 2.0, rules 1.12); every number is provisional

props.point: It thrusts. Typical riders: to-hit, armour ignored, pinning.
props.blunt: It crushes. Typical riders: Prone, Dazed, armour broken.
props.hook: It catches. Typical riders: pull, trip, disarm.
props.heavy: Mass. Melee: 3 AP an attack, knockback, hitting several. Ranged: must be Braced to work well.
props.light: Fast. 2 AP an attack; extra steps and strikes.
props.bare: A fist or a glove. Grapples and throws.
props.quick: Handy. Firing next to an enemy doesn't provoke; moving costs no accuracy.
props.auto: Throws many rounds. Pressure on a miss; several targets. Always offers Burst and Rake.
props.precise: A long barrel or glass. Better when you haven't moved; criticals.
props.spread: Shot or flame in a cone. Everyone close; breaks cover.
props.blast: It explodes. Aimed at a tile; Pressure to everyone in the radius.
props.silent: No report. Never reveals you; no Pressure on a miss, more on a hit from unseen; its pips are hidden.
props.loud: A cannon in the hand. A miss still gives Pressure; saves against it are harder.
props.drawn: Your arm is the powder. No Heat or Recoil; a quiver, not a magazine; it can't be reloaded in a fight.
props.shield: Carried in the off hand. It lends its own techniques, which run on Guard and Momentum.

items.name: Lunge
items.text: Step 1 tile toward the target, then strike. The step draws no opportunity attack.

lines.text: +{=numbers.point_hit} to hit.
the step may be {=numbers.reach_step} tiles.
on a hit the target is pushed {=numbers.heavy_push} tile.

items.name: Charge
items.text: After moving 3 or more tiles in a straight line this turn: strike at +10% damage per tile moved, up to +{=numbers.max_pct}%.

lines.text: ignores {=numbers.point_armour} armour.
the target makes a Body save or falls Prone.
you strike before it can take its Overwatch or Keep Back.

items.name: Feint
items.text: No damage. The target makes a Brain save against 12 + half your strength with the weapon's skill. If it fails, your next technique against it this turn has +{=numbers.hit} to hit and it can't use an Answer.

lines.text: the save is at −{=numbers.light_save}.
on a failed save its weapon is also lowered (1 AP to raise).

items.name: Draw Cut
items.text: Draw this weapon from the pack or a sheath and strike in one action. Only if you started the turn with it stowed.

lines.text: Bleeding on a hit.
if the target hasn't acted this fight, it counts as an ambush.

lines.text: crits on 18–20.

items.name: Cut

lines.text: a critical leaves Bleeding.
+{=numbers.point_hit} to hit.

lines.text: the arc is {=numbers.reach_out} tiles out.

items.name: Bash

lines.text: full damage.

costs {=lines.2.ap|abs} AP less.

items.name: Sunder
items.text: Strike at ×{=numbers.mult}. On a hit the target's armour is {=numbers.lower} lower for the rest of the fight (once per target per attacker).

lines.text: {=numbers.blunt_hook_lower} lower.
if the target has no armour left, Bleeding instead.

items.name: Flurry
items.text: Two strikes at ×{=numbers.mult} at one target, the second at {=numbers.later_hit} to hit.

lines.text: three strikes.
each hit after the first adds +1 to the next Bind or Throw Down this turn.
the strikes may go to two targets in throwing range; the weapons land in the pile on their tiles.

items.name: Hamstring
items.text: Strike at ×{=numbers.damage_mult}. The target makes a Body save or is Slowed {=numbers.slow_rounds} rounds.

lines.text: no save.
Prone instead of Slowed.

items.name: Bind
items.text: No damage. Lock the target's weapon with yours: until your next turn it attacks anyone but you at −2 and can't move away without a Body save. You can't use Reach while binding.

lines.text: Brain save or it is Disarmed.

items.name: Half-Sword
items.text: A short, driven thrust: ×{=numbers.damage_mult} damage, ignores {=numbers.armour_ignore} armour.

lines.text: ignores all armour.
full damage.
can't be used with this weapon.

items.name: Throw
items.text: Throw the weapon at a target in throwing range (Dexterity to hit). On a hit it stays in the target: it falls when the target does, or Pull Out from next to it brings it back. On a miss it lands on the target's tile.

lines.text: no penalty and full damage. Without Thrown: −{=numbers.unthrown_hit} to hit, ×{=numbers.unthrown_mult}.
the target makes a Body save or is knocked Prone.

items.name: Pull Out
items.text: Next to an enemy with a thrown weapon stuck in it: wrench it out. The weapon comes back into your hand, the target takes half the weapon's damage and is Bleeding. No roll. It costs no Momentum.

items.name: Sidestep
items.text: Move {=numbers.tiles} tile to another tile next to the same enemy. No opportunity attack. Your next Strike against it this turn ignores a carried shield and counts as flanking.

lines.text: {=numbers.light_tiles} tiles.

items.name: Guard
items.text: +{=numbers.defense} Defense against melee until your next turn, and your Momentum doesn't drop when you are hit. With Durability you also gain Guard: 1, +1 for each Durability point above 1, +1 with a shield.

lines.text: enemies must make a Body save to step next to you.
the +2 also applies to ranged attacks from the front.

items.name: Shove
items.text: Roll d20 + your Raw Power modifier against 10 + the better of its Raw Power and Athletics: on a win you push an enemy next to you 1 tile, or knock it Prone if it can't move back.

lines.text: 2 tiles.
from 2 tiles away.

items.name: Trip
items.text: The target makes a Body save or falls Prone.

lines.text: the save is at −{=numbers.save_penalty}.
you may go Prone with it and it is Grappled.

items.name: Drag
items.text: Pull an adjacent or reached target 1 tile toward you, or swap tiles with it (Body save).

lines.text: you pull from {=numbers.hook_tiles} tiles away (3 with Reach), up to {=numbers.hook_tiles} tiles.
you may move 1 tile and bring it with you.

items.name: Coup
items.text: One strike at +25% damage per Momentum spent.

lines.text: +{=numbers.edge_bonus_pct}% more against a target that is Bleeding, Dazed, Prone or Downed.
a hit is a critical if the target is at a quarter HP or less.

items.name: Cleave
items.text: One strike; then the same strike at one more adjacent enemy per Momentum spent, each at full damage.

lines.text: the extra targets may be 2 tiles apart.
every target hit bleeds.

items.name: Break
items.text: One strike. The target makes a Body save at −{=numbers.save_per_momentum} per Momentum spent or is Stunned (bosses: Dazed).

lines.text: its armour is also 0 for a round.
it is Disarmed as well.

items.name: Run Through
items.text: One strike at +{=numbers.per_momentum_pct}% per Momentum spent. On a hit the target is Pinned where it stands until it spends {=numbers.pull_free_ap} AP to pull free.

lines.text: ignores armour, and if a second enemy stands directly behind the first it is struck at half.

you may leave the weapon in (you are unarmed; the target stays Pinned until anyone next to it pulls it out for {=numbers.pull_free_ap} AP; you, or anyone not on its side, take it into a free hand). Without Point: −2 to hit.

items.name: Throw Down
items.text: Only on a target you have Grappled or Bound: slam it into a tile next to you. Damage ×1 + {=numbers.per_momentum_pct}% per Momentum, Prone, and the grapple ends. Anyone on that tile is struck at half and must save or fall Prone.

lines.text: no roll needed.
you may throw it {=numbers.heavy_tiles} tiles.

items.name: Parry
items.text: When a melee attack hits you: roll your attack skill against the attacker's roll. If you win, the hit does half damage. A shield in your off hand adds +2 to your roll. Uses your reaction.

lines.text: and you gain {=numbers.light_momentum} Momentum.
you may parry for an adjacent ally.

items.name: Riposte
items.text: When a melee attack misses you: strike back at the attacker for 0 AP. Uses your reaction.

lines.text: the strike back is at +{=numbers.edge_point_hit} to hit.

items.name: Keep Back
items.text: When an enemy steps into your reach: you strike it first. If you hit, it makes a Body save or stops where it is and can't come closer this move. Uses your reaction.
items.trigger: an enemy steps into your reach

lines.text: your reach is {=numbers.reach_tiles} tiles, so most enemies never arrive.
on a failed save it is also Prone.

items.name: Shot
items.text: One shot with your weapon. Every shooter knows it, and it is always ready.

lines.text: +1 if you haven't moved this turn.
a miss gives +{=numbers.loud_miss_pressure} Pressure.

items.name: Snap Shot
items.text: Draw or swap to this weapon and fire, at −2.

lines.text: no −2.
can't be used with this weapon.

items.name: Burst
items.text: Three rounds at one target, two rolls. The second roll is at −4 to hit.

lines.text: you may split the two rolls between two targets standing next to each other.
the second roll is at −3 instead of −4.
the second roll is at −1 instead of −4.

items.name: Aimed Shot
items.text: A careful shot at +{=numbers.hit} to hit.

lines.text: +{=numbers.precise_hit} to hit instead, and a critical hit on 18 to 20 if you haven't moved this turn.

items.name: Called Shot
items.text: −2 to hit. Choose leg (Slowed), arm (weapon lowered) or head (Dazed); the target makes a Body save.

lines.text: no −2.

can only be used within {=numbers.spread_range} tiles.

items.name: Walking Fire
items.text: Move {=numbers.tiles} tiles and fire one shot at any point of the move.

lines.text: {=numbers.quick_tiles} tiles, and no opportunity attacks.

can't be used with this weapon.

items.name: Punch Through

lines.text: the round carries on to the next target in line at half.
half cover is destroyed.

items.name: Lob
items.text: Fire at a target only an ally can see (through smoke or dark), at −4.

lines.text: over full cover, at −2.

items.name: Heavy Bolt
items.text: One bolt at +{=numbers.damage_pct}% damage that ignores 10 armour. On a hit the target saves (Body) or is pushed {=numbers.push} tile.

lines.text: +{=numbers.precise_hit} to hit.
costs {=lines.1.ap|abs} AP less.

items.name: Suppress
items.text: Fire to keep a target's head down: one roll at +2 to hit. A hit does half damage and gives it {=numbers.pressure_hit} Pressure. A miss still gives it 1 Pressure.

lines.text: enemies within {=numbers.auto_spill_range} tile of the target also gain +1.

it gives Pressure only on a hit.

items.name: Rake
items.text: Sweep fire across up to {=numbers.targets} targets that stand within 2 tiles of each other. Each shot is at {=numbers.hit} to hit, and each hit gives {=numbers.pressure} Pressure.

lines.text: full auto: {=numbers.auto_rounds} rounds in a cone. One roll at −2 against every enemy near the line to your target; each gains {=numbers.pressure} Pressure, hit or miss.

items.name: Warning Shot

lines.text: the save is at −{=numbers.loud_save_tn}.
can't be used with this weapon.

items.name: Flush
items.text: Shoot the target's cover, not the target. No roll: the cover takes the damage, and the target gains {=numbers.pressure} Pressure.

lines.text: double damage to the cover.

items.name: Mag Dump
items.text: Up to {=numbers.max_rolls} rolls at one target, {=numbers.rounds_per_roll} rounds a roll: with fewer left, one roll for every {=numbers.rounds_per_roll} or part, and it spends what is left. Each roll at −{=numbers.step} more than the last. +{=numbers.pressure} Pressure per hit. Heat goes to one under the limit.

lines.text: +{=numbers.pressure} Pressure per roll, hit or miss.

both barrels, one roll at double damage within {=numbers.spread_range} tiles.
can't be used with this weapon.

items.name: Crossfire

lines.text: +{=numbers.precise_hit} to hit it.

lines.text: allies also ignore one range band.

lines.text: removes the penalties it has when fired unbraced.

items.text: Chamber one special round you carry (armour-piercing, hollow-point, incendiary, enhanced) for your next Fire. The magazine stays as it is.

lines.text: not needed: you pick any arrow for every shot.

lines.text: {=numbers.quick_tiles} tiles.

lines.text: −{=numbers.heavy_heat} Heat (a barrel swap).

items.name: Head Down
items.text: Duck: remove {=numbers.pressure} Pressure from yourself, or {=numbers.full_cover_pressure} if you are behind full cover. You can't hold a shot (Overwatch and the like) this round.

items.name: Dead Centre
items.text: One shot at +{=numbers.damage_pct}% damage.

lines.text: +{=numbers.precise_hit} to hit.
ignores 5 armour.

items.name: Storm

lines.text: +{=numbers.quick_hit} to hit.

items.name: Last Round

items.suppressed: It can't be reduced by cover.

items.name: Overwatch
items.trigger: an enemy moves where you can see it
items.text: Hold your shot. The first enemy that moves where you can see it is shot at once, on its own turn. This uses your reaction and lasts until your next turn.

lines.text: The held shot is at +{=numbers.precise_hit} to hit.
The held shot is a Burst.
It only fires at an enemy that comes within {=numbers.spread_range} tiles of you.

items.name: Deny
items.trigger: an enemy steps onto the tile you picked
items.text: Pick a tile. The first enemy that steps onto it is shot at once. If the shot hits, that enemy stops there and loses the rest of its move. This uses your reaction and lasts until your next turn.

lines.text: While braced, you guard a row of 3 tiles instead of one.
The shot goes off as a blast on that tile.

items.name: Cover Me
items.trigger: an enemy attacks the ally you picked
items.text: Pick an ally. The first enemy that attacks them does it at −2 to hit and gains {=numbers.pressure} Pressure. This uses your reaction and lasts until your next turn.

lines.text: You cover two allies instead of one.
You also shoot the attacker.

items.name: Dead to Rights
items.trigger: the Pressed enemy you picked attacks, stands up, reloads or leaves cover
items.text: Pick a Pressed enemy. The moment it attacks, stands up, reloads or leaves cover, you shoot first, at +{=numbers.hit} to hit. This uses your reaction and lasts until your next turn.

lines.text: The shot is a critical hit on a roll of 18 to 20.
You stay Hidden after the shot.

items.name: Shield Bash
items.text: Strike with the shield: bare-hand damage ×{=numbers.mult}, hitting with Raw Power. It costs 1 Guard in place of 1 Momentum. On a hit you gain {=numbers.momentum_on_hit} Momentum, and the target makes a Body save or is pushed {=numbers.push} tile.

items.name: Raise Shield
items.text: Turn Momentum into Guard, 1 for 1, as much as you choose up to your pool. Until your next turn, ranged attacks from the front are at −2 to hit you.

items.name: Grapple
items.text: Grab an enemy next to you: it saves (Body) or is Grappled until it breaks free. No damage. Given by the perk Iron Grip.

items.name: Shield Wall
items.text: When an ally next to you is shot at: spend {=numbers.guard_cost} Guard and your reaction, and that ally counts as behind half cover against the shot (−{=numbers.half_cover} to hit them).
items.trigger: an ally next to you is the target of a ranged attack

items.name: Interpose
items.text: When an ally next to you is hit: spend {=numbers.guard_cost} Guard and your reaction, and you take the hit instead. Your armour applies, and the Guard you have left soaks it.
items.trigger: an ally next to you is hit by an attack
